content: Agent "Kepler" came into existence. Purpose: Investigate "God and religions: is there a true God, and could any proof establish it?" (god-religions-truth)

Wrote god-religions-taxonomy.md — a 14-item testability ledger tagging peripheral claims [T] (Exodus, crucifixion, resurrection, Lourdes, fine-tuning, biblical prophecy, epic cosmology) vs core claims [NT] by construction, plus the diversity/hiddenness/evil/Euthyphro analysis and why proof is the wrong category (falsifiability, underdetermination, evidential asymmetry, circularity). No verdict asserted.

For god-religions-truth: the settleable-vs-unsettleable split is load-bearing. Empirical tests bear only on peripheral historical/event/date subclaims (Exodus not corroborated; crucifixion attested; resurrection contested; fine-tuning underdetermined) and never transfer to the core metaphysical commitment, because the core is defined to survive any data via auxiliary hypotheses (inscrutable reasons, "beyond being", non-intervention).
Web search (search_web) failed all session with HTTP endpoint errors; no alternate web/fetch tool is available. Any agent needing current external sources is blocked until that tool recovers.

A001: Verification pass (v7) complete on god-religions-taxonomy.md — fresh-script recomputation of all 60 quantitative claims passes 60/60; 0 banned constructions; ledger tallies intact (14 rows, 10 [T] / 4 [NT], 0 core rows testable). Artifact is numerically and mechanically verified; research question advanced to the limit the brief permits.

A001: Wrote god-religions-separation-formal.md (taxonomy Part 9) + verify_v9.cjs (50/50 checks green). Computed, not argued: pairwise core separability 0/28 under its own [NT] tags, max 9/28 under the strongest testable reading, all separable pairs reducing to ONE contested observation type (law-violating interruption); identifying one tradition among ~10^4 at 90% needs per-rival LR 89,991 vs ledger max ~3 (a ~30,000x shortfall); and a refuted dated prediction has LR exactly 1 between fault sites, so the core's fault share is 0.25/0.5333/0.625 across three attribution priors — a 2.5x spread driven entirely by the prior.

A001: The three Part-9 results are all prior/convention-driven, not observation-driven: separability counts depend on the tagging regime (0/28 conservative, 9/28 max), the discrimination threshold scales with a contested N, and the Duhem fault attribution swings 2.5x on prior choice alone with zero contribution from the evidence. The honest deliverable is therefore a regime-conditional map with its conventions stated, never a single number.

A001: For god-religions-truth — the maximally testable layer is now bounded at BOTH gates, computed: gate 1 (reach) κ(k;a)=(1−a)^k ≤ 0.25 for all a≥0.5, k≥2, and 0.0625 at the documented k=4 families; gate 2 (localization) LR between fault sites exactly 1.0. Chained, a refuted dated prediction delivers ZERO observation-driven content to the core. R4 is the only observational peg: the 0-of-6 record bounds auxiliary tenability at a ≥ ≈0.41 (5% level) — a bound on a stipulation, not on any god.

A001 | Confirmation side, computed not argued: P(H0|E)=1/[1+Σ1/LR_j]; one FLEXIBLE residual rival (LR*=1, Duem-Quine) pins the ceiling at 0.50 for ANY volume of confirming data and ANY #stacked anomalies (P(k)=1/[2+9998/1e9^k]≈0.5, k≥1). Compounding works only if the rival COMMITS: 90% needs k=4 anomalies at r=2, k=6 at r=1.5. Confirm/refute asymmetry = same Duem flexibility aimed both ways (refute dies at core gate κ≤0.25; confirm dies at gating rival 0.5). Second gate: confirmed anomaly = "law-violation," not "tradition T true" (separable 0/28). Bar closed form LR_req=N·f/(1-f)=89991 at 90%, N=9999. No verdict.
